title: Use your Codex in Telegram, Slack & Discord
excerpt: All of Wirebot, none of the DevOps — no VPS to rent, no Docker to babysit, no updates at 2 a.m.
content_html:
Kick off tasks from any chat,
then close the laptop.
Codex keeps working — and you
never pay us for tokens.

Requires a ChatGPT plan with Codex access
Wirebot is not affiliated with OpenAI

Actually,
it’s better than Codex in your terminal

With Wirebot, Codex runs on a dedicated server that never shuts down.
​
Full shell, real browser, persistent disk. It can now:

Spin up a landing page for my sauna side project — dark, minimal

Live on port 3000 ✓ Next.js + Tailwind. Screenshot:

PNG preview.png1.4 MB

Vibecode from your phone

Describe it in chat, get a running app back. Codex scaffolds, codes and screenshots it on a real dev server — while your laptop stays closed.

ZIP legacy-app.zip212 MB

Port this PHP mess to Next.js. Take your time

Done — 14 commits, tests green ✓ Repo stays cloned for next round

A dev box, not a sandbox

Full shell and a disk that persists: apt installs, Docker, node_modules and cloned monorepos are still there tomorrow. Nothing to re-set-up.

While you were away

Deploy failed — new worker was missing DATABASE_URL. Added it, re-ran: green ✓

What broke it?

a3f9c12 — I left a comment on the PR 👀

On call, so you aren’t

Failing CI, webhooks, error alerts — Wirebot watches your stack in the background and messages you with the fix, not just the alert.

Anything waiting on me?

PR #218 — flaky-test fix, 12 lines, CI green. Safe to ship

Merge it

Merged & deployed ✓

Merge PRs from bed

Your gh auth and repo context live on the server. Review diffs, comment and merge from any chat — no laptop required.

Host Wirebot in our cloud
for just $7.99/mo

All of Wirebot, none of the DevOps —
no VPS to rent, no Docker to babysit,
no updates at 2 a.m.

  • Live in 60 seconds — connect Codex and start shipping
  • Dedicated always-on server — repos, dotfiles and sessions persist
  • Long jobs run 24/7 — builds and crons don’t need your laptop open
  • Automatic updates, backups and monitoring — zero maintenance
  • Your own isolated box — full shell, nothing shared with anyone

$7.99/mo

Billed monthly · cancel anytime · plus tax

Connect Codex

We check your plan’s Codex eligibility before you pay
